history.name: A typeface that can't be embedded is flagged
history.description: Asking for a typeface the tool doesn't carry still produces a document — printed in whatever the machine has — but says so both when the record is checked and when the edition is built, along with the warning that its text may not copy cleanly. The trade-off is a decision rather than a surprise.
history.dev_notes: fontFaceCss() returns embedded: false; warned by both cmdCheck and renderLedgerHtml.
